determinism: Every document is canonical JSON with one trailing newline. Regenerating under a different temporary directory, a different LANG, or a different checkout path reproduces these bytes; the suite asserts it.

documentPurpose.expected-file-grain.json: What collapseToFileGraph must produce from projection.json, including the order of every list.
documentPurpose.expected-neighbourhoods.json: What structuralNeighbourhood must produce for seven pinned seed sets, including the degradation cases.
documentPurpose.projection-superseded.json: The same snapshot's projection after a second index published a new head. Byte-identical to projection.json except identity.headSnapshotId, which isolates exactly the field a currency check reads. The collapse still succeeds and still answers, because every row is true of the snapshot it names. WHETHER TO USE IT IS THE CONSUMER'S CALL: there is no stale boolean here and there must not be one in a consumer's copy either.
documentPurpose.projection.json: The fixture's consumer projection at head. The input every conformance test parses.

provenance: Generated from evaluation/vectors/file-grain-collapse/fixture-sources.json only. The fixture is authored in this repository and contains no material from any benchmark repository, any measured project, or any held-out task. No projection of any real repository is committed here, and none may be: a projection frozen from a held-out task's parent commit would put repository structure into a prompt input and destroy the measurement.
